source: This is a cache-size equivalence, not a literal architecture with 2.25 KV heads. Head counts are discrete. The comparison says that ZXNAME0000XZ’s ZXNAME0001XZ cache stores as many elements as a hypothetical conventional ZXNAME0002XZ cache with 2.25 groups.ZXMATH0000XZ
zh: 这是缓存大小的等价，而不是具有 2.25 KV 磁头的字面架构。人数是离散的。比较表明，ZXNAME0000XZ 的 ZXNAME0001XZ 缓存存储的元素与假设的常规 ZXNAME0002XZ 缓存（具有 2.25 个组）一样多。ZXMATH0000XZ
